notes: All required searches ran this time (8 searches in total, none refused). The site-restricted search returned no pages from gluesenkampperez.house.gov; the topic searches (superintelligence, existential risk, pause/moratorium, China agreement, AI safety) returned no result mentioning her. A general search on her name and artificial intelligence returned only biography and profile pages; the one AI-related hit was a Yahoo News page of reader letters (https://ca.news.yahoo.com/letter-writers-weigh-federal-state-120000401.html), not her own words, and it was not opened. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538): the FastDemocracy bill page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/), opened 14 November 2026, lists 12 cosponsors (Khanna, Mejia, Ansari, Hoyle, Lynch, Garcia, Deluzio, Grijalva, Velazquez, Ocasio-Cortez, Randall, Tonko) and she is not among them; this was not checked against Congress.gov, so a later cosponsorship cannot be ruled out. No House letter on AI risk by her was found (the large multi-member House letters were deliberately not searched, per instructions). From the earlier attempt (still valid): her official homepage's four most recent news items (26 October to 11 November 2026) did not mention AI, and https://gluesenkampperez.house.gov/press returned 'No press releases found', so her older press releases were not read directly; coverage of her official site relies on the site-restricted search.
